changeSet.author: nexus-ykzbj.8
changeSet.comment: SELECT-only grants for the nexus_diag diagnostic role (RDR-182 P2.1). LEGACY-era: applies only while nexus.diag_chash_conformance is absent — the era test is the second guard in the body below, NOT a preCondition (nexus-ixsxa; see the header note on MARK_RAN row growth). Conditional on the role existing (clean skip otherwise; self-heals every startup via runAlways). ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES runs as this migration connection's role (nexus_admin — the creator of every schema table), so future tables are covered automatically. Read-only by construction: SELECT on tables plus the Liquibase journal; deliberately NO sequence usage, NO DML, NO EXECUTE on the soft-delete functions.

changeSet.author: nexus-9bufb
changeSet.comment: Amendment A6 (nexus-9bufb): VIEW-era grants. Once the superuser provisioning path has created nexus.diag_chash_conformance, the diagnostic role's content boundary becomes structural: revoke direct table SELECT (nexus_admin owns the tables and made the original grants, so it can revoke them), keep schema USAGE, the counts view, and the Liquibase journal. Idempotent + runAlways: self-heals every boot, and re-revokes anything the legacy changeset era granted. The era test is the second guard in the body below, NOT a preCondition (nexus-ixsxa; see the header note on MARK_RAN row growth).

changeSet.author: nexus-8yz1p
changeSet.comment: bead nexus-8yz1p (2026-08-16): nexus_diag gets staging schema SELECT, ERA-INDEPENDENT. Deliberately its OWN changeset rather than folded into grants-nexus-diag-1's body: the LEGACY/VIEW split above is specifically the RDR-182 s5 chash-poison content boundary on nexus/t1 -- staging (the RDR-180 land-then-transform landing zone, FORCE RLS + tenant policy on every table, staging-001-landing-tables.xml) carries no such content-boundary concern and no counts view to narrow into, so it must grant identically in both eras. A single-changeset placement would force an impossible choice: before diag-1's era guard, and it trips ChangelogBulkGrantConformanceTest's allowlistedOccurrence_isStillGatedByViewAbsence tripwire (which asserts the FIRST bulk "ON ALL TABLES" grant found in grants-nexus-diag-1's body sits after the era guard -- a sound invariant for the nexus/t1 grant it was written to protect, but not one this era-independent grant should be measured against); after the guard, and it would be silently skipped in the view era, defeating the whole point. A separate changeset id sidesteps the tripwire's substring scan entirely (which slices ONLY id="grants-nexus-diag-1"'s body) without editing that test's assertion, and reads as the more honest shape besides: this grant is not part of the era dance at all. Same role-existence guard as -1/-2 (self-heals every boot); read-only by construction, matching -1's own construction.
